N01.python:
SELECT notifications.id, notifications.recipient_id, notifications.type, notifications.title, notifications.message, notifications.data, notifications.is_read, notifications.created_at 
FROM notifications 
WHERE notifications.recipient_id = %(recipient_id_1)s::UUID AND coalesce(CAST((notifications.data ->> %(data_1)s) AS BOOLEAN), %(coalesce_1)s) IS false ORDER BY notifications.created_at DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s OFFSET %(param_2)s
N01.rust:
SELECT notifications.id, notifications.recipient_id, notifications.type, notifications.title, notifications.message, notifications.data::text, notifications.is_read, notifications.created_at
FROM notifications
WHERE notifications.recipient_id = $1::uuid AND coalesce(CAST((notifications.data ->> $2) AS BOOLEAN), $3) IS false
ORDER BY notifications.created_at DESC
LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
